item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 20/Jan/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an intense winter monsoon and a broad band of clouds, it will be persistently cold over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The temperature rise during the day will be relatively small. The monsoon is expected to be replaced by a fresh to strong easterly airstream gradually during the weekend to early next week. Temperatures will rise progressively over the coast of southern China, but it will still be cool in the morning. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Nokaen will move across the seas east of the Philippines and dissipate gradually today and tomorrow.
